results.bug: Wrong parameter in null check (grantType vs. rawTokenId)

matched.title: Null check meant for rawTokenId checks grantType again, so null rawTokenId passes

results.judgeReason: Finding #0 points at AccessTokenContext.java line 73, where the null check meant for rawTokenId tests grantType again instead. That is the same root cause as the known bug. It also explains the impact: a null rawTokenId is never validated and gets accepted at construction.
